caption: The drawing depicts a ceremonial staff or scepter lying diagonally on a plain, light-colored background. The staff is predominantly dark, with the shaft appearing black or very dark grey, extending from the lower left to the upper right of the image. The tip on the left end is pointed and metallic grey. The head of the staff features three white or light grey birds with black-tipped wings and red detailing around their eyes and beaks, positioned so their wings and tails curve outward. The section where the birds are attached is decorated with small red and blue circular details. The drawing is enclosed within a simple double-line rectangular border. There is faint text in the bottom right corner, indicating the artist's signature and identification numbers.
title: Glass Pen
